verdict.rationale: vLLM's own documentation lists tensor, pipeline, and data parallelism (plus expert and context parallelism) as built-in distributed inference capabilities. That directly covers every mode the story names, but the support is a single feature-list line. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on configuring multi-GPU parallelism (flags or settings such as parallel sizes, multi-node setup), and independent or hands-on corroboration of distributed inference working in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can distribute inference across multiple GPUs using tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism

citations.quote: Tensor, pipeline, data, expert, and context parallelism for distributed inference
